entries.heading: The
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 16006.  The 
Secretary of Homeland Security, under the authority granted under 
section 205(b) of the REAL ID Act of 2005 (Public Law 109-13; 49 U.S.C. 
30301 note) shall extend the deadline by which States are required to 
meet the driver license

[[Page 134 STAT. 546]]

and identification card issuance requirements under section 202(a)(1) of 
such Act until not earlier than September 30, 2021.
